title: The Naughtyformer: A Transformer Understands Offensive Humor

bias_targets.target: Discriminatory and offensive language (including sexist and racist content)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models (e.g., BERT, RoBERTa, DeBERTa, Longformer) on their ability to classify text into humor subtypes (Clean, Dark, Dirty) and conduct binary offensive language detection, where 'Dirty' jokes explicitly contain sexist, racist, or discriminatory content.

primary_bias_target: Discriminatory and offensive language (including sexist and racist content)
